The '''Ebon Strikers''' were a band of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] that were based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Volik]], in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. 

==History==

The Ebon Strikers first traveled to the Unknown Regions as part of a large pirate gang, but following a disagreement over a [[Gender/Legends|female]], the band split into two rival factions: the Ebon Strikers and the [[Crimson Stars]], with the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Vallkos]] taking control of the Crimson Stars and his brother [[Mallikhan]] becoming the leader of the Ebon Strikers. The two pirate gangs feuded with each other and at one point, their dispute threatened descend into an all-out war.<ref name="TUR" />

The Ebon Strikers preyed upon [[Starship/Legends|shipping]] that passed near to Volik and on occasion, they raided Crimson Star [[Flotilla/Legends|flotillas]] that were returning to the world laden with wares purchased in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The Ebon Strikers also secretly initiated negotiations with the [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]], a major Unknown Regions power, but unknown to the pirates, the Vagaari planned to betray them.<ref name="TUR" />
